frequency_question: How often do central banks implement incremental reserve ratio requirements when liquidity surpluses spike within a given multi-year horizon?
membership_rule: Includes mandatory secondary reserve ratio impositions on commercial bank deposits designed to mop up surplus liquidity over a defined temporary period. Excludes standard permanent cash reserve ratio hikes or repo rate changes.

cases.name: People's Bank of China Targeted Reserve Requirement Ratio actions
Central Bank of Sri Lanka Statutory Reserve Ratio adjustments on specific foreign currency deposits

coverage_note: 3 named episodes representing major emerging market jurisdictions; broader global instances exist but are structurally distinct.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier markets with idiosyncratic capital controls.
skeleton: Major emerging market central bank liquidity absorption cycles over the last 15 years, filtered for targeted reserve ratio tools.
multiplier: 3 observed major deployment episodes across comparable large emerging market jurisdictions facing acute liquidity overhangs in a 15-year window.
validity_reason: Central bank liquidity management toolkits evolve slowly over multi-year regulatory regimes.
